title: Unavailable measurements become false percentage changes
reasoning: The scb-check failure path legitimately returns no verbosity measurement, but delta computation converts that missing value to zero. A failed measurement after a successful checkpoint therefore reports a 100% verbosity reduction. Recovery after an unavailable measurement reports infinite growth. These are measurement failures presented as quality changes.
reproduction: Call compute_checkpoint_delta with previous verbosity=4 and current metrics lacking verbosity: delta.verbosity is -100. Reversing the missing and measured checkpoints produces infinity.
recommendation: At the checkpoint delta boundary, omit the delta or return null when either measurement is absent or null. Preserve the existing zero-denominator behavior for actual numeric zero measurements.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: None of the supplied tests exercises checkpoint delta extraction or an scb-check failure between successful measurements.
suggestedRegressionTest: Cover measured-to-missing, missing-to-measured, both-missing, and genuine zero-valued measurements for every DELTA_METRIC_KEYS entry, including an orchestration scenario where scb-check fails.
minimumFixScope: Guard unavailable values in compute_checkpoint_delta and add coverage distinguishing missing measurements from numeric zero.
